messages:
julia: Quick question — where should I look for traces + logs for the batch-embed job? We're seeing worker spans drop intermittently and the alert on span-loss is firing a lot. Any dashboard links or quick checks? :wave:

omar: Start with the traces dashboard (Tempo/Jaeger) for request flow: https://grafana.internal/redwood/traces — filter service=batch-embed and time ~ last 6h. Also check the 'span drop rate' panel on Observability -> Ingest.

julia: thanks — I can't find the dashboard panels you mentioned under my view. Is that perms or am I looking in the wrong org?

ben: You might be in the user org view. Use the global org (top-left org selector) or the direct link to the team dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/ops/batch-observability?panel=7

sai: For missing spans, quick checks: 1) confirm OTLP exporter is actually sending (check exporter success metric: otlp_exporter_send_success_total). 2) check sampler config — low TraceIDRatio can drop entire traces. 3) look for instrumentation gaps (async workers often drop context).

julia: where is the sampler config stored? I recall there was a central sampler + overrides per service?
emily: Sampler is configured in infra repo under infra/observability/otel/configs/service-samplers.yaml. Default production sampler is parentbased_traceidratio with rate=0.02. We have per-service overrides in that same file (batch-embed currently inherits default).

matt: If you need to debug a specific run, temporarily flip the sampler for batch-embed to 0.2 for a short window. Example snippet (in our helm values):

```
service:
  name: batch-embed
  otel:
    sampler:
      type: parentbased_traceidratio
      ratio: 0.2
```

apply via: ./bin/obsctl apply -f values/batch-embed-sampler.yaml --namespace=observability-canary

julia: nice. Is there a quick way to tell if spans are being emitted but not linked (orphaned) vs not emitted at all?
omar: Query the span count metric per service: otel_spans_received_total{service="batch-embed"}. If spans show up but traces are short, you have propagation/context loss. If counts drop to zero, exporter/SDK not sending.

ben: For context loss in async workers, look for missing traceparent headers in the logs. Example grep in logs: `grep -R "traceparent" /var/log/batch-embed/* | head` — we log headers at debug there.

julia: any alert tuning suggestions? we get noisy pager nights when a single worker restarts and misses spans for 5 minutes.
sai: For alert tuning, increase window and require rate > threshold and sustained for N minutes, e.g. alert if span_loss_rate > 0.1 for 10m. Also add a suppression when deployment in progress (we annotate releases).

infra-bot: deploy observable-configs commit abc1234 applied to observability-canary (sampler change requested by matt).

julia: I flipped the canary sampler to 0.2 and re-ran the failing job, I can now see full traces for that run. Looks like propagation issue in worker pool. Will open a tiny PR to add context propagation in the job runner.

matt: SG. Ping me for code review and I'll merge the propagation fix + metric for header loss.

julia: thanks all — putting steps in the issue: 1) check otel_spans_received_total 2) try canary sampler 3) grep for traceparent in logs 4) deploy context-propagation patch.

emily: also linked a short how-to doc: https://wiki.internal/redwood/observability/async-tracing-guide — includes debug commands and dashboard links.

julia: perfect, closing the loop. :tada:
